name: C-10 plasburst cannon
description: The C-10 plasburst cannon was a model of plasburst laser cannon that could be equipped to starships. The cannon would charge up and launch a powerful laser. Equipping an EML-850 light freighter with a C-10 plasburst cannon cost two thousand credits and required a X-FP-C28 ship computer, twenty units of quadanium steel, and eight heuristic processors.
